I read both files from the working tree. `responseParser.ts` has uncommitted changes, so the line numbers below come from the current working copy, not from `HEAD`.

**`src/server/conversation/responseParser.ts`** has two named module-level functions:
- `scanFences` (lines 25–51) is not exported. It scans markdown for fenced code blocks. It only keeps an unclosed fence when that fence's language is the model fence language (`MODEL_FENCE_LANGUAGE`).
- `parseAssistantResponse` (lines 53–93) is exported. It calls `scanFences` directly on line 55, then turns the fences into markdown, diagram or code blocks.

**`src/server/model/repositoryModelStore.ts`** has one class:
- `RepositoryModelStore` (lines 12–41) has two public methods besides the constructor:
  - `get` (lines 20–22) returns a deep copy of a repository's model.
  - `merge` (lines 25–40) adds new entities and relations to the stored model, matched by id, and checks size limits. It does not call `get`.

I left out what you asked me to: the constructor, private fields, interfaces, and the module-level constants `scope` and `repositoryModels`. The only direct call between the included items is `parseAssistantResponse` → `scanFences`. Nothing in one file calls anything in the other.
